ideas.reasoning: I favor B: separating exploratory parent retention from strict incumbent promotion gives this comparison more information per remaining episode without additional LLM calls. The positive selection estimates do not establish real progress, but the gate can prevent small cumulative gains from reaching confirmation. Untouched confirmation avoids ordinary selection-set optimism, although it does not erase the outcome-informed amendment or restore independence between overlapping grammar RNG streams.
suggested_changes: Record B as an outcome-informed pilot amendment, preserving the original specification, observed decisions, amendment timestamp and old/new config hashes; do not describe the amended study as wholly preregistered.

For every arm, block and round, retain the highest-success policy among the parent and candidates satisfying the paired drop-difference one-sided 95% upper bound <= 0.05; ties favor the parent, then the earlier candidate. Continue reporting the original Holm tests and duplicate-parent diagnostics, without treating selection wins as established improvements.

Recompute completed decisions from saved rows only. Before resuming, verify that no round-2 edit or training child depends on a parent the amendment replaces; if one does, return for a decision rather than silently regenerating, retraining or reusing an incompatible descendant.

Leave grammar seeding and existing edits as registered. Report the shared RNG streams and actual repeated edits explicitly; the blocks are not three independent grammar-search replicates. Retain the registered across-block summaries, but label their t intervals nominal and exploratory rather than calibrated independent-search uncertainty.

Retain the prediction: paired_success_difference, direction increase, threshold 0.05, against grammar evolution with identical ARS and evaluation allocation. Retain falsified_by as an across-block interval upper bound below 0.05, with the dependence caveat; an interval including zero establishes no advantage. Claim no structural contribution unless a structural arm also beats fixed fitting under the declared confirmation criteria.

Keep confirmation manifests, strict paired promotion/drop criteria and the saved incumbent unchanged. Freeze all finalists before confirmation, do not adapt again to interim outcomes, and never access final-test.

Reuse scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml with the existing structural-search implementation. The amendment adds 0 simulator episodes and 0 controller-generation calls; retain approximately 2,050,000 total starts, the 2,300,000 ceiling and 24-call maximum, including the 6 calls already spent. Resume only unexecuted allocations and reuse completed artifacts, never relaunching a spent child seed.
